//@version=6
indicator("lab")
bool active = time >= timestamp("2026-09-26T00:00:00+0000")
var int k = -1
if active
    k += 1
plot(k, "k")
float w = active ? (k * 13) % 17 : 0
float v_lr_c3 = na
float v_lro_c3 = na
float v_rci_c3 = na
float v_lr_cr = na
float v_lro_cr = na
float v_rci_cr = na
float v_lr_cl = na
float v_lro_cl = na
float v_rci_cl = na
float v_lr_c10 = na
float v_lro_c10 = na
float v_rci_c10 = na
if active and (k % 3 != 0)
    v_lr_c3 := ta.linreg(w, 5, 0)
    v_lro_c3 := ta.linreg(w, 6, 2)
    v_rci_c3 := ta.rci(w, 5)
if active and ((k * 7) % 11 < 6)
    v_lr_cr := ta.linreg(w, 5, 0)
    v_lro_cr := ta.linreg(w, 6, 2)
    v_rci_cr := ta.rci(w, 5)
if active and (k % 24 < 12)
    v_lr_cl := ta.linreg(w, 5, 0)
    v_lro_cl := ta.linreg(w, 6, 2)
    v_rci_cl := ta.rci(w, 5)
if active and (k % 10 != 5)
    v_lr_c10 := ta.linreg(w, 5, 0)
    v_lro_c10 := ta.linreg(w, 6, 2)
    v_rci_c10 := ta.rci(w, 5)
plot(v_lr_c3, "lr c3")
plot(v_lro_c3, "lro c3")
plot(v_rci_c3, "rci c3")
plot(v_lr_cr, "lr cr")
plot(v_lro_cr, "lro cr")
plot(v_rci_cr, "rci cr")
plot(v_lr_cl, "lr cl")
plot(v_lro_cl, "lro cl")
plot(v_rci_cl, "rci cl")
plot(v_lr_c10, "lr c10")
plot(v_lro_c10, "lro c10")
plot(v_rci_c10, "rci c10")

labPct.script:
//@version=6
indicator("lab")
bool active = time >= timestamp("2026-09-26T00:00:00+0000")
var int k = -1
if active
    k += 1
plot(k, "k")
float a = not active ? 0 : k % 4 == 0 ? na : (k * 37) % 101 + 1
float b = not active ? 0 : k % 3 != 0 ? na : (k * 37) % 101 + 1
float c = not active ? 0 : (k % 10 < 4) ? na : (k * 37) % 101 + 1
plot(ta.percentile_linear_interpolation(a, 5, 50), "pli a 5 50")
plot(ta.percentile_nearest_rank(a, 5, 50), "pnr a 5 50")
plot(ta.percentile_linear_interpolation(a, 6, 30), "pli a 6 30")
plot(ta.percentile_nearest_rank(a, 6, 70), "pnr a 6 70")
plot(ta.percentile_linear_interpolation(b, 5, 50), "pli b 5 50")
plot(ta.percentile_nearest_rank(b, 5, 50), "pnr b 5 50")
plot(ta.percentile_linear_interpolation(c, 5, 50), "pli c 5 50")
plot(ta.percentile_nearest_rank(c, 5, 50), "pnr c 5 50")
plot(ta.percentile_nearest_rank(c, 5, 0), "pnr c 5 0")
plot(ta.percentile_nearest_rank(c, 5, 100), "pnr c 5 100")
plot(ta.percentile_linear_interpolation(c, 5, 0), "pli c 5 0")
plot(ta.percentile_linear_interpolation(c, 5, 100), "pli c 5 100")
plot(a, "a")
plot(b, "b")
plot(c, "c")
